**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Frances](../persons.html#1604),
[Uncle Yonge](../persons.html#1623) did not go today. I am sorry to say he has quite got a cold. [Helen](../persons.html#1613) is very well and bright – Here is a curiosity by way of a German announcement of a betrothal
Your affect Sister

C M Yonge

[^1]: The letter must date between the birth of Helen Yonge and the death of the Rev.

John Yonge.
